name: io.github.Servosity/zoom-phone-mcp
title: Zoom Phone MCP
description: Zoom Phone admin API plus E911, call routing and desk phone audits across client accounts

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the ZOOM_PHONE_ACCOUNT_ID credential for the Zoom MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the ZOOM_PHONE_CLIENT_ID credential for the Zoom MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the ZOOM_PHONE_CLIENT_SECRET credential for the Zoom MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Zoom Phone API. Leave the prefilled default.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint the Server-to-Server OAuth exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank: a Zoom Server-to-Server OAuth token carries the scopes added to the app.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. It does not select a Zoom account. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to refuse every write and every secret-returning read. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. The audits that read the local mirror then report nothing assessed. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_MCP_UPLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A folder MCP file uploads (audio library files) may be read from by path. Leave blank: uploads then take base64 file content and the server reads no local path.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Zoom requests. Leave blank to use the built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: ZOOM_PHONE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
